name: Debit Authorisation
definition: Permission given by an account owner to debit its account as the result of a cancelled payment. The authoriser is the party whose account was credited as the result of a payment instruction.

ValueDateToDebit.name: Value Date To Debit
ValueDateToDebit.definition: Value date for debiting the amount.

DebitAuthorisationDecision.name: Debit Authorisation Decision
DebitAuthorisationDecision.definition: Code expressing the decision taken by the account owner relative to the request for debit authorization.

AmountToDebit.name: Amount To Debit
AmountToDebit.definition: Specifies the amount to debit when the amount is lower than the amount of the underlying transaction.

AuthorisedReturn.name: Authorised Return
AuthorisedReturn.definition: Authorisation given by a credited party to return the payment which was the reason for the credit and therefore to debit its account.

RelatedInvestigationCaseResolution.name: Related Investigation Case Resolution
RelatedInvestigationCaseResolution.definition: Payment investigation case resolution which is the source of the debit authorisation.
